note: Gold SQL uses {ref} = dataset reference date. Gold returns the minimal columns; the prediction may return extra columns.

sql_questions.question: How many leads are there in total?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads

sql_questions.question: How many leads are stale?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE is_stale

sql_questions.question: How many leads have a bounced email address?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE email_status = 'bounced'

sql_questions.question: How many leads have an invalid email address?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE email_status = 'invalid'

sql_questions.question: How many deals are there in total?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deals

sql_questions.question: How many open deals do we have?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deals WHERE stage NOT IN ('Closed Won','Closed Lost')

sql_questions.question: What is the total value of all open deals?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM deals WHERE stage NOT IN ('Closed Won','Closed Lost')

sql_questions.question: What is our total closed-won revenue?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM deals WHERE stage = 'Closed Won'

sql_questions.question: What is the average size of a closed-won deal?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(amount_usd) FROM deals WHERE stage = 'Closed Won'

sql_questions.question: How many deals are in each stage?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT stage, COUNT(*) FROM deals GROUP BY stage

sql_questions.question: What is the total deal value in each stage?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT stage, SUM(amount_usd) FROM deals GROUP BY stage

sql_questions.question: How many leads are there per industry?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT industry, COUNT(*) FROM leads GROUP BY industry

sql_questions.question: How many leads are there per country?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM leads GROUP BY country

sql_questions.question: How many leads came from each source?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT source, COUNT(*) FROM leads GROUP BY source

sql_questions.question: What is the open pipeline value per industry?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT l.industry, SUM(d.amount_usd) FROM deals d JOIN leads l USING (lead_id) WHERE d.stage NOT IN ('Closed Won','Closed Lost') GROUP BY l.industry

sql_questions.question: Show the top 10 leads by priority score.
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT lead_id FROM lead_scores ORDER BY rank LIMIT 10

sql_questions.question: What are the 5 largest open deals?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT deal_id FROM deals WHERE stage NOT IN ('Closed Won','Closed Lost') ORDER BY amount_usd DESC, deal_id LIMIT 5

sql_questions.question: Which open deals are worth more than $50,000?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT deal_id FROM deals WHERE stage NOT IN ('Closed Won','Closed Lost') AND amount_usd > 50000

sql_questions.question: Which open deals are expected to close in the next 30 days?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT deal_id FROM deals WHERE stage NOT IN ('Closed Won','Closed Lost') AND expected_close_date BETWEEN DATE '{ref}' AND DATE '{ref}' + INTERVAL 30 DAY

sql_questions.question: Which open deals are past their expected close date?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT deal_id FROM deals WHERE stage NOT IN ('Closed Won','Closed Lost') AND expected_close_date < DATE '{ref}'

sql_questions.question: Which open deals have been in the same stage for 45 days or more?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT deal_id FROM deals WHERE stage NOT IN ('Closed Won','Closed Lost') AND date_diff('day', last_stage_change, DATE '{ref}') >= 45

sql_questions.question: Which deals in Negotiation are worth more than $30,000?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT deal_id FROM deals WHERE stage = 'Negotiation' AND amount_usd > 30000

sql_questions.question: How many deals are in the Negotiation stage?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deals WHERE stage = 'Negotiation'

sql_questions.question: What is the total value of deals in Proposal Sent?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM deals WHERE stage = 'Proposal Sent'

sql_questions.question: What is the largest single deal amount?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(amount_usd) FROM deals

sql_questions.question: How many demo requests happened in the last 30 days?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity WHERE type = 'demo_request' AND activity_date >= DATE '{ref}' - INTERVAL 30 DAY

sql_questions.question: How many activities of each type are there?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT type, COUNT(*) FROM activity GROUP BY type

sql_questions.question: Which leads had a meeting in the last 30 days?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT lead_id FROM activity WHERE type = 'meeting' AND activity_date >= DATE '{ref}' - INTERVAL 30 DAY

sql_questions.question: How many pricing page visits have there been in total?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity WHERE type = 'pricing_page_visit'

sql_questions.question: How many leads have no activity at all?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE lead_id NOT IN (SELECT lead_id FROM activity WHERE lead_id IS NOT NULL)

sql_questions.question: How many leads have no deals?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE lead_id NOT IN (SELECT lead_id FROM deals WHERE lead_id IS NOT NULL)

sql_questions.question: How many duplicate records were merged?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM merges

sql_questions.question: How many merges were made by each matching rule?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT rule, COUNT(*) FROM merges GROUP BY rule

sql_questions.question: Which leads have not been contacted in more than 90 days?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT lead_id FROM leads WHERE days_since_contact > 90

sql_questions.question: What is the average company size per industry?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT industry, AVG(company_size) FROM leads GROUP BY industry

sql_questions.question: How many leads work at companies with more than 1000 employees?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE company_size > 1000

sql_questions.question: How many call notes does each author have?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT author, COUNT(*) FROM notes GROUP BY author

sql_questions.question: How many call notes are there in total?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes

sql_questions.question: Which leads have at least 10 activities?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT lead_id FROM activity GROUP BY lead_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10

sql_questions.question: How many deals are Closed Lost?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deals WHERE stage = 'Closed Lost'

sql_questions.question: What is the average open deal amount per stage?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT stage, AVG(amount_usd) FROM deals WHERE stage NOT IN ('Closed Won','Closed Lost') GROUP BY stage

sql_questions.question: Which countries have more than 100 leads?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT country FROM leads GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(*) > 100

sql_questions.question: How many leads were created in the last 90 days?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE created_at >= DATE '{ref}' - INTERVAL 90 DAY

sql_questions.question: What is the total open pipeline belonging to stale leads?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(d.amount_usd) FROM deals d JOIN leads l USING (lead_id) WHERE d.stage NOT IN ('Closed Won','Closed Lost') AND l.is_stale

sql_questions.question: How many leads have more than one deal?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT lead_id FROM deals GROUP BY lead_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) t

sql_questions.question: What is the average priority score per industry?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT industry, AVG(score) FROM lead_scores GROUP BY industry

sql_questions.question: Which open deals belong to the top 20 ranked leads?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT d.deal_id FROM deals d JOIN lead_scores s USING (lead_id) WHERE s.rank <= 20 AND d.stage NOT IN ('Closed Won','Closed Lost')

sql_questions.question: What is the total value of open deals closing within the next 60 days?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM deals WHERE stage NOT IN ('Closed Won','Closed Lost') AND expected_close_date BETWEEN DATE '{ref}' AND DATE '{ref}' + INTERVAL 60 DAY

sql_questions.question: Which industries have more than $1,000,000 in open pipeline?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT l.industry FROM deals d JOIN leads l USING (lead_id) WHERE d.stage NOT IN ('Closed Won','Closed Lost') GROUP BY l.industry HAVING SUM(d.amount_usd) > 1000000

sql_questions.question: How many closed-won deals and how much revenue does each industry have?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT l.industry, COUNT(*), SUM(d.amount_usd) FROM deals d JOIN leads l USING (lead_id) WHERE d.stage = 'Closed Won' GROUP BY l.industry
